decisions.statement: Use a private neutral representation for Core agent authoring while preserving public Pack v1 and external .agent.md pack sources.
Factory receives explicit inputs and target-neutral validators; target-specific validation remains in each target adapter.

manifest.description: Create a neutral canonical Core-agent source and remove implicit Factory assumptions about Core while preserving Pack v1 and pluginctl runtime behavior.

lifecycle.commit_reason: TASK-6-07 implementation was committed after independent QA and Reviewer approval. Tracking documentation is being committed separately. Remote publication is blocked because the approved Agentic Core GitHub MCP is unavailable in this session.
lifecycle.workspace_note: The shared checkout remains untouched. The isolated worktree and branch are preserved for GitHub App publication; the current session exposes only the hosted GitHub connector, which repository policy does not authorize for mutations. No remote changes were made.

open_blockers.reason: Installed pluginctl runtime was verified on Linux only; no Windows runner was available.
A separate SWE pack does not exist in this repository; generic Core-plus-Pack composition is tested, but a real Core-plus-SWE profile is not.
pluginctl remains Agentic Core lifecycle management and PluginController._compose always loads Core; the standalone expertise Factory explicit-catalog API is tested without Core.

The SDD coverage validator reports historical implementation revision mismatches and completed prior/gate tasks without current-revision implementation evidence. Historic proofs were preserved without retagging.

The current tool inventory exposes the hosted GitHub connector but not the approved Agentic Core GitHub MCP. Repository policy forbids using the hosted connector or user credentials for remote mutations; local commits and worktree are preserved.

plan.approval: Orchestrator approved Planner plan r2 addendum for TASK-6-07 through TASK-6-09.

No authentication, authorization, secrets, or trust-boundary behavior is changed; technical Reviewer gate remains selected.

acceptance_criteria.statement: All nine agents project deterministically from one neutral canonical source to Copilot, Codex, and Antigravity.
Factory resolves and compiles a supplied pack/catalog without locating Agentic Core source paths.
Semantic validation is target-neutral and target projection validation is owned by each adapter.
Core-only, Core+SWE, and Factory-only composition are accurately supported or explicitly reported partial/blocked, without implicit Core inclusion.
Installed pluginctl runs from arbitrary CWD without checkout or PYTHONPATH; Linux and Windows evidence is explicit.

The generator extracts the shared agent-policy portion of AGENTS.md through the closing risk_assessment section; repeated generation is byte-identical to the checked-in .github/copilot-instructions.md.
Pack schema v1 behavior remains compatible and existing fixtures/lifecycle tests pass.

constraints: No public agent ABI or Pack v1 change
Use only the configured GitHub App MCP for GitHub mutations
specification.objective: Remove Copilot-owned Core-agent sources and implicit Core assumptions from Plugin Factory without a public Pack v1 or agent ABI change.

requirements.statement: The nine Agentic Core agents have one harness-neutral canonical source and reproducible Copilot, Codex, and Antigravity projections.
Generic Factory layers consume explicit catalogs, validators, targets, or an existing minimal equivalent rather than discovering Core from repository paths.
Semantic validation is target-neutral and target projection validation remains with each target adapter.
Composition can represent Core-only, Core+SWE, and Factory/plugin-engineering-only without silent Core inclusion, or records the concrete limitation.
Generated installed pluginctl runs from arbitrary CWD without a repository checkout or PYTHONPATH; platform evidence is explicit.
Copilot instructions are generated deterministically from the shared agent-policy portion of AGENTS.md.
Expertise Pack schema v1 and its observable behavior remain compatible.
